description: Known differences between a runtime's G2P output and phoneme_test_cases_golden.json (generated by Python). Each runtime's golden parity test fails when a case differs and is not listed here for that runtime, and also when a listed case starts to match, so fixed entries must be removed. status 'planned': the linked issue will fix it. status 'accepted': an exact match is not a goal (the reason says why); the entry stays until the output matches. Checked by scripts/check_g2p_known_divergences.py.
